title: Model judgments; evidence and run metadata are bound by drive.py

gloss.description: Translation required when the source language differs from the delivery language.

scope.description: Required only for partly_true: which part is supported and its limits.

inference.description: Required only for no_official_text or not_checked; distinguish interpretation from platform facts.

unreached_source.description: Required for not_checked: selected source_id or watch URL also recorded in unreachable_sources.

checked_sources.description: Required for no_official_text: relevant selected source IDs actually read, not proof of platform-wide absence.

unreachable_sources.description: Explain failed pages in the user's language; also mark navigation-only pages that could not answer the claim. Other failures remain automatically included.
